course-search.name: Course Seeker
course-search.purpose: National undergraduate course search and comparison.
course-search.limits: Not a substitute for the current course page or admissions advice from the provider.

course-search.name: ComparED
course-search.purpose: Government comparison data for student experience and graduate outcomes.
course-search.limits: Compare providers and study areas; it does not confirm course entry requirements.

course-search.name: My Shortlist
course-search.purpose: Independent comparison of undergraduate courses and student outcomes, with a published data methodology.
course-search.limits: Coverage is limited to participating universities; use it as a comparison layer.

course-search.name: Open Universities Australia
course-search.purpose: Online degrees, subjects and short courses from marketplace partners.
course-search.limits: Commercial marketplace with partner-only and online-focused coverage; not a complete course catalogue.

pathway-search.name: Skills NSW course finder
pathway-search.limits: Confirm current course availability, fees and eligibility with the provider.

pathway-search.name: training.gov.au
pathway-search.purpose: National Register of VET qualifications, training packages and registered providers.
pathway-search.limits: Registration does not guarantee a course is currently offered at a particular location.

pathway-search.name: Australian Apprenticeships
pathway-search.purpose: National apprenticeship and traineeship pathway information.
pathway-search.limits: Pathway guidance rather than a current vacancy listing.

pathway-search.name: ReachOut: TAFE study
pathway-search.purpose: Student-friendly context on vocational study and possible pathway experiences.
pathway-search.limits: General guidance only; providers decide course credit, eligibility and enrolment terms.

pathway-search.name: Workforce Australia job search
pathway-search.purpose: Current advertised jobs, including jobs suitable for new entrants.
pathway-search.limits: Vacancies change quickly; confirm requirements with the employer.

pathway-search.name: TAFE NSW course catalogue
pathway-search.limits: Course availability, fees and entry requirements vary by location and intake.

pathway-search.name: myfuture
pathway-search.purpose: Career exploration, interests and occupation profiles for students.
pathway-search.limits: Use as an idea-generation resource; confirm training and job requirements with official providers.

pathway-search.name: National Apprentice Employment Network
pathway-search.purpose: Apprenticeship support information and pathways to local Apprentice Connect Australia Providers.
pathway-search.limits: The network is a discovery and support route; provider services and eligibility can change.

subject-alignment.name: NSW university course pages
subject-alignment.purpose: Admissions-centre course listings for participating NSW institutions.
subject-alignment.limits: Always follow through to the institution’s live course page for prerequisites and assumed knowledge.

subject-alignment.name: Course Seeker
subject-alignment.purpose: National undergraduate course comparison with entry information.
subject-alignment.limits: Course and subject advice can change; verify with the provider.

subject-alignment.name: My Shortlist
subject-alignment.purpose: Independent comparison to help students explore course options and outcomes.
subject-alignment.limits: Partial university coverage; not an authority for prerequisites or admission decisions.

scholarships.name: Award provider source pages
scholarships.purpose: Official starting point for scholarships; individual records link to the award sponsor or provider.
scholarships.limits: Provider award pages control current eligibility, dates, amounts and application steps.

scholarships.name: Study Work Grow scholarship search
scholarships.purpose: Independent discovery across scholarships, grants, accommodation and equity support.
scholarships.limits: Discovery only. Confirm each award with its sponsor before relying on details.

scholarships.name: Country Education Foundation
scholarships.limits: Use the individual provider page to check current award conditions.

scholarships.name: Aurora Foundation scholarship search
scholarships.purpose: Scholarship discovery for Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander students.
scholarships.limits: Check each award’s official terms and application status.

scholarships.name: Refugee Education Australia
scholarships.purpose: Scholarship and support discovery for people from refugee backgrounds.
scholarships.limits: Confirm current eligibility and award details with the provider.

scholarships.name: CAAT scholarship catalogue
scholarships.purpose: Searchable independent catalogue spanning Australian providers.
scholarships.limits: Broad catalogue; not all awards fit regional NSW school leavers or undergraduate entry.

timelines.name: UAC key dates
timelines.purpose: Current application, offer and admissions dates for UAC processes.
timelines.limits: University early-entry and scholarship dates may be published separately by each institution.

timelines.name: University admission scheme pages
timelines.purpose: Official admissions pathway starting point for UAC and participating institutions.
timelines.limits: Confirm the named program’s current cycle dates on the institution’s own page.

timelines.name: Study Work Grow events and open days
timelines.purpose: Additional event discovery alongside admissions timelines.
timelines.limits: Dates can be outdated; do not treat as the source of a deadline.

financial-planning.name: Services Australia Payment Finder
financial-planning.purpose: Personal estimate and eligibility route for government payments.
financial-planning.limits: An estimate is not a determination; the agency decides eligibility.

financial-planning.name: MoneySmart student budgeting
financial-planning.purpose: Student cost categories and practical budget guidance.
financial-planning.limits: General planning information, not a student payment assessment.

financial-planning.name: headspace: finance your studies
financial-planning.purpose: Youth-centred explanation of study costs, moving and looking for support.
financial-planning.limits: Use for planning prompts; government entitlement rules come from the responsible agency.

financial-planning.name: National Debt Helpline
financial-planning.purpose: Free, independent financial counselling and referral for financial hardship.
financial-planning.limits: Counselling and referral, not a payment eligibility decision.

checklist.name: Your Career
checklist.purpose: Government career exploration and training information.
checklist.limits: Confirm course, entry and employment arrangements with the relevant provider or employer.

checklist.name: Services Australia
checklist.limits: Personal eligibility is determined by Services Australia.

checklist.name: headspace: leaving secondary school
checklist.purpose: Wellbeing, routine, living and support topics that complement administrative tasks.
checklist.limits: General wellbeing guidance, not admissions or clinical advice.

checklist.name: The Smith Family post-school plans checklist
checklist.purpose: Additional prompts for course exploration, open days and conversations with supporters.
checklist.limits: Use official providers for actions, dates and requirements.

study-hubs.name: Australian Government University Study Hubs finder
study-hubs.purpose: Current finder for regional and suburban University Study Hubs nationally, including the NSW hub set.
study-hubs.limits: The finder lists physical locations; this directory groups related sites under their hub program or operator.

study-hubs.name: Country Universities Centre directory
study-hubs.limits: CUC is one hub network, not the whole national program.

study-hubs.name: Regional University Study Hubs Network
study-hubs.purpose: Network cross-check of community-run hub locations.
study-hubs.limits: Directory information can lag; verify individual details with the local centre.

study-hubs.name: Study Hubs Australia
study-hubs.purpose: Sector and community context on study hubs and support models.
study-hubs.limits: Context only; does not set every centre’s facilities or access rules.

calendar.name: UAC key dates and events
calendar.purpose: Admissions deadlines, offer dates and listed events.
calendar.limits: Confirm the date and registration details with the event host where applicable.

calendar.name: TAFE NSW events
calendar.purpose: TAFE NSW open days, information sessions and events.
calendar.limits: Event details may change; check the organiser before attending.

calendar.name: NAPSA NSW/ACT careers events
calendar.purpose: Independent careers-adviser association calendar for NSW and ACT careers events.
calendar.limits: Discovery only; confirm details with event organisers.

calendar.name: Study Work Grow careers events
calendar.purpose: Additional discovery for careers expos, information sessions and workshops.
calendar.limits: Third-party listings can change; publish or export only after organiser confirmation.
